model_output.verdict: An experienced structural and pipe welder whose inspection record makes the work stand out.
write_up: Your welding experience is strong because you show both the work and how it was checked! A recruiter can see your move from pipe welding at Great Lakes Mechanical to structural welding and fit-up at Maumee Steel Fabricators, with the certifications to match.

The Riverfront Tower line is your best model: it names the job, the third-party inspections and about 900 welds. Your fit-up line also gives a tolerance, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess how precise the work is.

I'd keep the inspection line prominent and add what you worked on during plant shutdowns. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; the match with each job and the competition for it will matter too.
